paper.title_en: Complete Second-Order Relativistic Derivation of the Observed Pulsar Timing Modulations
paper.abstract_en: We present a fully nonlinear relativistic description of the observed pulsar timing modulations, defined through the ratio of the proper-time intervals between two successive emissions of radio pulses and their observations by a pulsar timing array. Working in the limit of a vanishing emission interval, we derive the observed pulsar timing modulation to second order in relativistic perturbation theory around a Minkowski background, without fixing a gauge and retaining the full scalar, vector, and tensor content of the metric perturbations. Although the derivation naturally introduces several gauge-dependent intermediate quantities, we explicitly demonstrate that they combine into a coordinate-independent expression. Moreover, we explicitly show that the second-order timing modulation from two neighboring radio pulses coincides with the observed redshift, defined as the fractional change in wavelength along a single geodesic. The agreement represents a nontrivial second-order realization of the exact nonlinear equivalence proven in Magi & Yoo 2026.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在脉冲星计时阵观测框架下，于闵可夫斯基背景上不做规范固定地推导至二阶的相对论性脉冲星计时调制，保留标量、矢量与张量自由度，并显式证明结果可组合为坐标无关表达式，且与单条测地线上观测红移的二阶结果一致；理论深度与推导严谨性突出，适宜精读。
decision.title_zh: 观测到的脉冲星计时调制的完整二阶相对论性推导
decision.abstract_zh: 我们给出了对观测到的脉冲星计时调制的一个完全非线性的相对论性描述，其定义为脉冲星计时阵所观测到的、两次连续射电脉冲发射之间的固有时间隔与相应观测之间的固有时间隔之比。在发射间隔趋于零的极限下，我们在围绕闵可夫斯基背景的相对论微扰论中推导至二阶，得到观测到的脉冲星计时调制，且不固定规范，并保留度规微扰的全部标量、矢量与张量内容。尽管该推导自然引入若干依赖规范的中间量，我们仍明确证明它们组合成一个坐标无关的表达式。此外，我们明确表明，来自两个相邻射电脉冲的二阶计时调制与观测到的红移一致，而后者定义为沿单条测地线的波长分数变化。这一一致是 Magi & Yoo 2026 中所证明的精确非线性等价关系的一个非平凡二阶实现。
